scientific_integrity: The all-parameter claim is established by a written exhaustive structural proof. A separate C++17 checker independently tested finite parameter instances, and these tests are explicitly not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats ordinary zero forcing and token-jumping reconfiguration on joins of a clique of order at least two and a path of order at least four. It does not classify all possible realizations of barbell graphs. Searches cannot exclude unindexed equivalent prior work; external independent validation has not been performed.
title: The zero-forcing reconfiguration graph of a clique–path join is a barbell
